resultText:
Confirmed — App.tsx never calls the standalone `getNonDeletedElements`, only `this.scene.getNonDeletedElements()`. Final answer:

Of the files calling the standalone `mutateElement` helper, these also call the standalone `getNonDeletedElements` helper (not the Scene method, not a module-local shadow):

1. `packages/excalidraw/clipboard.ts`
2. `packages/element/src/frame.ts`

The rest of the `mutateElement` callers (`packages/excalidraw/components/LayerUI.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/components/ConvertElementTypePopup.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionFrame.ts`, `packages/element/tests/sortElements.test.ts`, `packages/element/tests/duplicate.test.tsx`, `packages/element/src/linearElementEditor.ts`, `packages/element/src/fractionalIndex.ts`, `packages/element/src/flowchart.ts`, `packages/element/src/delta.ts`, `packages/element/src/binding.ts`, `packages/element/src/Scene.ts`) either don't call `getNonDeletedElements` at all or only call it via `scene.getNonDeletedElements()`/`this.scene.getNonDeletedElements()` (the class method) — and `Scene.ts` itself only calls its own module-local `getNonDeletedElements` (defined at `packages/element/src/Scene.ts:50`), not the package export.

Confirmed — App.tsx does not import the standalone `getNonDeletedElements`; all 129 occurrences are `this.scene.getNonDeletedElements()` (the Scene method). App.tsx is excluded.

Final answer — files that call `mutateElement` **and** also call the standalone `getNonDeletedElements` (from `packages/element/src/index.ts`, imported directly, not `scene.getNonDeletedElements()` nor a local re-implementation):

1. `packages/excalidraw/components/Stats/utils.ts`
2. `packages/excalidraw/components/Stats/MultiDimension.tsx`
3. `packages/excalidraw/components/Stats/Dimension.tsx`
4. `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx`
5. `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionFrame.ts`
6. `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionFlip.ts`
7. `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionDeleteSelected.tsx`
8. `packages/element/src/frame.ts`

Excluded despite calling something with the same name: `packages/element/src/Scene.ts` (defines its own module-local helper, distinct from the export), and `packages/element/src/linearElementEditor.ts`, `packages/element/src/dragElements.ts`, `packages/element/src/binding.ts`, `packages/element/src/arrows/focus.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` (all only call the `Scene` class method `scene.getNonDeletedElements()`).
